mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 38 degrees and clear near Badger Ridge Middle School. The First Quarter moon is out, and if you are up early, look to the sky at 5:39 AM to see the International Space Station rising over Mount Horeb and heading high across the sky toward Fitchburg and Madison.

In city news, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver on Thursday after reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students. Also, the city continues to maintain updated zoning and sign ordinances, and residents are reminded to double-check their designated polling locations before upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, you can check out the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga classes at Insight Wellness start Sunday, and various trivia nights begin on Monday at the Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and The Bogey Factory.

Regarding the incident on Thursday, the Verona Police Department successfully arrested a school bus driver for operating while impaired. Alcohol was not a factor, and police are currently investigating if the bus struck a traffic sign during the incident, but thankfully no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently closed, but you can head over when they open today at 10:00 AM.
